title: The Techno Global University Act, 2008 (Act No. 5 of 2008)
full_text: The Techno Global University Act, 2008 (Act No. 5 of 2008) Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act Number: 5 Enactment Date: 2006-12-01 Act Year: 2008 Short Title: The Techno Global University Act, 2008 (Act No. 5 of 2008) Long Title: An Act to establish and incorporate a University in the State, with emphasis on providing high quality and industry-relevant education in the areas of Physical Sciences, Life Sciences, Technology, Medical Science and Paramedical, Management, Finance & Accounting, Commerce, Humanities, Languages & Communication, Applied and Performing Arts, Education, Law, Social Science and related areas sponsored by Techno India, Kolkata, West Bengal and to provide for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
